Name: Provide description for all visible measures
Description: All visible DAX measures should have a meaningful description explaining their business logic and computation to end users and report builders.
FixExpression: Description = "TODO: Provide business description for " + Name

Name: Set format string on numeric measures
Description: All visible measures must have an explicit format string defined (e.g. currency, integer, percentage) to prevent raw unformatted numbers in visuals.
FixExpression: FormatString = Name.Contains("%") or Name.Contains("Rate") ? "0.0%" : Name.Contains("$") or Name.Contains("Revenue") or Name.Contains("Amount") or Name.Contains("Price") or Name.Contains("Cost") ? "$#,##0.00" : "#,##0"

Name: Organize measures into display folders
Description: Measures should be categorized into logical display folders (e.g., '01 - Revenue & Volume', '02 - Margins', '03 - Time Intelligence') for seamless report authoring.
FixExpression: DisplayFolder = Name.Contains("YoY") or Name.Contains("MoM") or Name.Contains("PY") ? "05 - Time Intelligence" : Name.Contains("Margin") or Name.Contains("Profit") ? "02 - Margins & Profitability" : Name.Contains("Order") or Name.Contains("AOV") ? "03 - Order Metrics" : Name.Contains("Customer") ? "04 - Customer Metrics" : "01 - Revenue & Volume"

Name: Centralize measures in dedicated measure table
Description: Measures should not be scattered across Fact or Dimension tables; they should reside in a dedicated '_Measures' table.
Expression: Table.Name != "_Measures" and Table.Name != "Key Measures" and Table.Name != "_measures"

Name: Use DIVIDE function instead of division operator (/)
Description: Use DIVIDE(numerator, denominator, alternateResult) instead of the '/' operator to safely handle divide-by-zero errors without expensive IF(ISBLANK()) checks.
Expression: Expression.Contains("/") and not Expression.Contains("DIVIDE(") and not Expression.Contains("//")

Name: Hide relationship foreign keys in Fact tables
Description: Foreign keys used in 1:N relationships (e.g., customer_id, product_id in Fact tables) should be hidden from end-users to force slicing via Dimension tables.
Expression: IsHidden = false and Table.Model.Relationships.Any(r => r.FromColumn == this)

Name: Hide surrogate date/dimension keys
Description: Surrogate integer keys (e.g. datekey) used for internal joins should be hidden from report builders.
Expression: IsHidden = false and (Name.EndsWith("key", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) or Name.EndsWith("_id", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) and not Table.Name.StartsWith("dim_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)

Name: Do not hardcode Windows local drive paths in M partitions
Description: M partition expressions should not contain hardcoded 'C:\Users\...' paths. Use environment parameters or relative repository paths.
